# UX Checklist: Árvores declaradas

**Purpose**: Validate the quality of the UX requirements for the declared tree screen, the approval gallery and the one-time warning for old Pins and marks
**Created**: 2026-11-20
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the levels of the tree (pool, system group, source, children, leaf) and what each one shows (name, value, emoji) specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-013]
- [x] CHK002 Is it specified what the player sees for a source that belongs to another class, so that it is never shown as a zero line? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002a]
- [x] CHK003 Is the content of the ⓘ of each line (curve, branch checks, how the pools join) specified for the declared tree? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, §FR-013]
- [x] CHK004 Are the elements of each gallery card (the tree image, the number's name, the system, "Aprova", "Corrigir + nota") specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-024]
- [x] CHK005 Is it specified where the gallery shows how many trees a change of recipe or rule changed, and grouped how? [Completeness, Spec §FR-022, §US3]
- [x] CHK006 Is the text and the place of the one-time warning about old Pins and marks specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-028]
- [x] CHK007 Is it specified what the gallery shows for a tree that the lock rejected or that is still waiting for a recipe? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK008 Is the value format of each line type (Additive "+N%", Multi "×N", leaf values) defined for the declared tree, or explicitly inherited from the 009? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK009 Is "a imagem igual à que o jogador vê" defined clearly enough (open or closed groups, which branches open) for the gallery capture? [Clarity, Spec §FR-023]
- [x] CHK010 Is the order of the system groups inside a pool defined for the declared tree? [Clarity, Gap]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Is "all pools and groups start closed" (FR-013) consistent with the gallery image, which must show the tree's shape to be approved? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, §FR-023]
- [x] CHK012 Is "the system always appears as a child" (FR-014) consistent with hiding the class-only sources (FR-002a) when a whole system only has sources of other classes? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, §FR-002a]
- [x] CHK013 Is the "no extra line when the tree does not close" rule (FR-019) consistent with "each level closes with the parent" (FR-015) as the player sees it? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, §FR-019]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK014 Are the requirements for "Needs the live map" in the declared tree stated? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK015 Is it specified what happens on the screen while live values arrive and a source's value goes to 0 or ×1? [Coverage, Spec §FR-017, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK016 Is it specified what the player sees when a number has no approved recipe yet during the feature? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK017 Are keyboard and screen reader requirements stated for the gallery buttons and the note field? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK018 Are the tree's accessibility requirements (the 009 treeview announcements) explicitly kept for the declared tree? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK019 Is a time limit stated for the gallery of one world to open? [Measurability, Gap]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
